en.title: 26 U.S.C. §642(b)(2)(C)(iii)(II) indexes “the $4,150 amount in subparagraph (A)”, which holds $100
en.summary: Subclause (II) increases “the $4,150 amount in subparagraph (A)” for inflation. Subparagraph (A) of §642(b)(2) contains $100; the $4,150 amount is in subclause (I) of the same clause, which substitutes it for the exemption amount while that amount is zero.
en.correction: Refer to the $4,150 amount in subclause (I).

quotes.source: Office of the Law Revision Counsel, United States Code, Title 26, release point 119-121 (XML)
quotes.text: the $4,150 amount in subparagraph (A) shall be increased in the same manner as provided in section 6334(d)(4)(C).
